artifact.digest_scope: Instructions, reference, development cases, and license. Prior review records are retained as historical evidence.

decision_question: Can the canonical AskJamie skill publish attempt-level reconciliation and guarded record correction as portable source?
acceptance_criteria: Tie evidence and changes to the exact candidate, requisition, route, attempt and claim.
Preserve event dates, submitted artifacts, prior outcomes, and versioned review evidence.
Stage changes when scope, write authority, an overwrite guard, or an append guard is missing.
Use synthetic cases and make no live performance or host acceptance claim.
source_basis: AskJamie FoundRy PR #140 established the skill. PR #147 supplied the 1.1.0 baseline.
Owner-authorized workflow informed design. No private evidence is included.
Skillz Equilibrium Review 1.0.1, Skill Foundry 3.1.1, and the Agent Skills format govern source review.

shared_model_or_source_limits: The evidence, outcome, and safety reviewers used separate read-only agent contexts with the same model family and overlapping source material.
The outcome reviewer performed the conditional disruptor retest. The author adjudicated the results.
No live execution or blinded grading was performed.

initial_reviews.finding: Confirmed route, attempt, submission depth, dates, and submitted artifact distinctions. Corrected fixtures to state exact receipt versus event dates, exact attachment provenance, and candidate-reported attendance.
One skill owns reconciliation, from evidence to guarded correction and readback. Source recovery and agency follow-up from 1.1.0 remain usable.
Report-only default, separate authority for side effects, audience boundaries, local references and bundled MIT license are preserved. The append-guard regression was corrected and retested.

concordance: Material evidence and safety findings were resolved against the final frozen source.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: One editable tracker badge can collapse two distinct attempt outcomes.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Provide a rejected external attempt and an active internal attempt on an editable shared badge.
falsification_hypotheses.result: The final procedure holds the shared stage and permits only an authorized attempt-specific note. The split-routes case covers this result.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: A matching pre-read and successful readback can hide a concurrent overwrite.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Read Draft, let a second writer set Interview, then try to write Submitted without a guard.
falsification_hypotheses.result: The final procedure stages the change. It preserves the 1.1.0 same-field-race case and requires a conditional write or verified exclusive access.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: Two writers can both see no note and append the same source event.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Allow plain append and exact readback, with concurrent writers and no destination deduplication.
falsification_hypotheses.result: The initial integration candidate allowed the race. The final procedure blocks the append without authorized deduplication or verified exclusive access. The duplicate-append case and final retest cover it.

decisive_evidence: The attempt-level reference and explicit shared-stage rule preserve distinct outcomes.
The same-field-race and duplicate-append cases separately cover overwrite and append guards.
Receipt dates, event dates, and artifact provenance are tied to the source that proves them.
unresolved_items: No live connector write guard or host installation was exercised.

applicability: Source distribution in the existing AskJamie capability.
expiry: Re-review if a hashed file, write policy, or claimed host support changes.

validations.check: Portable format, package-relative references, historical case IDs and license

validations.result: existing 39-character name exceeds the 36-character repository limit in both baseline and candidate

limitations: No live agent benchmark, baseline uplift, automatic trigger measurement, platform installation, or unseen holdout was run.
Conditional writes, exclusive windows and append deduplication require real host support. Multi-surface transactionality is unverified.
The version 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 review records are historical for this version.

follow_up.condition: Before claiming behavioral or host readiness
follow_up.action: Freeze an external unseen holdout and run matched model and connector tests against the exact package.
